g.text: Causes serious eye irritation. Harmful to aquatic life with long lasting effects.
Contains: Eucalyptol, Terpinen-4-ol, alpha-Pinene, beta-Caryophyllene, beta-Pinene, l-LimoneneMay produce an allergic reaction.

Avoid release to the environment. IF IN EYES: rinse cautiously with water for several minutes. If eye irritation persists: get medical advice.Dispose of contents and container in accordance with local regulations.
